svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Change data capture pipeline architecture on AWS. 1. The developer seeds and queries RDS over psql on port 5432 (publicly accessible). 2. Debezium reads the write-ahead log by logical decoding (pgoutput) through the replication slot 'debezium'. 3. MSK Connect produces CDC JSON to the Kafka topic rds.public.users on MSK. 4. The connector pulls its plugin through the S3 gateway endpoint, 5. which serves the Debezium ZIP from S3 with no NAT gateway or internet path. 6. Connector workers send their logs to CloudWatch Logs. 7. The IAM role, granting S3 read and CloudWatch Logs access, is the connector's service execution role. One security group: self-referencing between the services, plus the developer's /32 on 5432 and 9092. PLAINTEXT on 9092 is a lab setting.
svg.text: Public subnets · 2 AZs (RDS subnet group, MSK brokers and MSK Connect span both)
The developer seeds and queries RDS over psql on port 5432 (publicly accessible).
Debezium reads the write-ahead log by logical decoding (pgoutput) through the replication slot 'debezium'.
MSK Connect produces CDC JSON to the Kafka topic rds.public.users on MSK.
The connector pulls its plugin through the S3 gateway endpoint,
which serves the Debezium ZIP from S3 with no NAT gateway or internet path.
Connector workers send their logs to CloudWatch Logs.
The IAM role, granting S3 read and CloudWatch Logs access, is the connector's service execution role.
Dashed lines are the control plane: plugin download, logs and the execution role.
One security group: self-referencing between the services, plus the developer's /32 on 5432 and 9092.
PLAINTEXT on 9092 is a lab setting.
